title: Petrol Stations Near Me: Fuel Stations Mapped
description: Find petrol stations near any place with Petrol Stations Near Me — stations mapped from open data, ranked by distance, prices honestly excluded. Free.
summary_sentence: For example, a driver at a quarter tank in unknown country gets the ranked stations in seconds — and gets them without a fake price column, because this page's intro says plainly that no free source publishes trustworthy live fuel prices.
quick_answer: Petrol Stations Near Me maps fuel stations recorded near a place or your location, ranked by distance. Search, press find, and choose from the map or ranked list. Prices are deliberately not shown — no free source publishes trustworthy live prices — so prices are left to the stations.

faq: Why are there no fuel prices?

Because no free data source publishes trustworthy live prices, and an invented or stale price column would be worse than none. The page states this up front — stations and distances are facts; prices live at the pump and on the brands' own channels.
Every station the open record holds — majors, supermarkets and independents alike, ranked by distance rather than by network.
Can I use the tool without sharing my precise location?
Yes — search a place name; location is optional.
Why might a boundary or place name look different elsewhere?
Station brands rebrand and change hands; the map record carries the name at recording time.
Does MapBench store my browser location?
Map data ages where nobody edits. OpenStreetMap accepts the correction from anyone who knows.
Service-area stations are recorded like others and usually appear — the road context on the map shows which side and junction.
Where mappers recorded fuel types, the detail exists; coverage varies. The station's own signage is the final word.
Can it plan a whole route?
Chain points along the route; the Service Coverage Gap Finder specialises in the long-gap version of the question.
